categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: photovoltaic (PV) products and wear-resistant new materials. The PV segment focuses on the research, production, and sales of high-efficiency N-type monocrystalline silicon rods, silicon wafers, and heterojunction (HJT) specialized silicon wafers. The wear-resistant materials segment provides energy-saving solutions and products such as grinding balls, liners, and hammer heads for industries like mining, cement, and thermal power.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including large-size monocrystalline silicon rod pulling, fine wire sawing for wafer slicing, and chain impurity-gettering processes to enhance silicon wafer purity and efficiency. It has developed ultra-thin G12 (40μm) half-cut wafers and 100μm HJT specialized wafers. In wear-resistant materials, it applies high-efficiency ball milling energy-saving technology and controlled ion penetration (PIP) surface strengthening technology, recognized as internationally advanced.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly downstream photovoltaic cell and module manufacturers requiring high-efficiency N-type silicon wafers, and industrial clients in mining, cement, and thermal power sectors for wear-resistant materials. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong focus on expanding overseas PV markets. Major customers include top-tier PV companies with long-term framework contracts.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly in mainland China, accounting for over 96% of revenue, with a growing presence in overseas markets. Manufacturing bases are located in Yunnan (Dali), Anhui (Xuancheng), and Shandong provinces. The company actively pursues international market expansion through strategic partnerships and participation in global PV exhibitions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of core materials such as monocrystalline silicon rods and wafers. It also extends into downstream applications by providing integrated smart energy solutions including microgrids and virtual power plants. In wear-resistant materials, it supplies critical components used in industrial machinery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in high-efficiency N-type silicon wafer technology and smart energy applications aligned with new power system development. R&D priorities include developing compatible thermal fields for crystal pulling, advanced cleaning processes, large-diameter monocrystalline silicon equipment, and tungsten wire sawing technology. The company also invests in digital transformation and cost reduction to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of photovoltaic products (silicon rods, wafers) and wear-resistant materials (grinding balls, liners, hammer heads). The company also earns income from technology services, entrusted processing, and smart energy solution projects. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales contracts with major industrial and PV customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the high-efficiency N-type silicon wafer market with advanced production capacity and technology. It faces intense competition due to industry overcapacity and price declines but leverages its technological innovation and strategic partnerships to maintain competitiveness. It is recognized among the top global photovoltaic silicon wafer enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, a 12.17% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 297.6 million. Despite losses, the company expanded production capacity and invested heavily in new projects, increasing total assets by 49% to RMB 3.65 billion. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity ramp-up and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced N-type high-efficiency silicon wafer technology, including ultra-thin and heterojunction specialized wafers, which improve photovoltaic conversion efficiency and reduce costs. Its proprietary impurity-gettering process enhances product quality. In wear-resistant materials, it offers customized, energy-saving solutions with internationally recognized surface strengthening technology, providing customers with improved durability and operational efficiency.
